description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two models, MMAU (blue bars) and MMAR (purple bars), across three different audio-based tasks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three tasks in alphabetical order. For the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct task, the MMAU model achieved an accuracy of 50%, while the MMAR model achieved 30%. For the Audio-Reasoner task, the MMAU model achieved 60% accuracy, and the MMAR model achieved 35%. For the Qwen-2.5-Omni task, the MMAU model achieved 65% accuracy, and the MMAR model achieved 55%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each task, with the MMAU bars consistently taller than the corresponding MMAR bars, and the chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars by value.
